notes.title: Jaki's Wacky Adventure Launches under the Wolf Moon 1-25-24
notes.content:
[h1]Jaki made it to Chillgrave Keep - are you brave enough to go inside?[/h1]
[h2]Find out when the wolf moon rises - Jan 25, 2024![/h2]

Thank you for all of your patience that last year.
Two scheduled launches were delayed - but the game is bigger and better than ever.
3 major quest lines and over 40 side quests to enjoy.
Open-world exploration and action packed combat for hours of fun.

Play testers have described Jaki's Wacky Adventure as the essence of Skyrim meets the adventurous spirit of Zelda. 

JWA provides hours of game play experience. JWA was inspired by the games that I love - Skyrim, Fallout 4, Mass Effect Legendary and Zelda. So hopefully you will feel their presence as you wander around Harmony Haven. Solve a murder, chase a killer, and battle clever bosses!

See you during the Wolf Moon!

Jaki finally made it to Chillgrave Keep - but are you brave enough to go inside? Find out soon.

notes.title: Jaki's Wacky Adventure is excited to announce a new challenging quest line!
notes.content:
[h1]Jaki's Wacky Adventure plans to launch on the WOLF MOON - Jan 25, 2024 EST.[/h1]

[h2]Jaki's Wacky Adventure is inspired by the creativity of Who Framed Roger Rabbit and Space Jam.[/h2]

[h2]Open World RPG[/h2]
The world of Harmony Haven is an amazing open world with over 30 unique areas to explore and two distinct settings - "real life" juxtaposed with Toon Town (a colorful cartoon land) and Jaki's home town.

[h2]Main Quest: Return home to Toon Town & solve a murder.[/h2]
The main quest line sends Jaki back home to use her CSI skills to solve a murder and hopefully avenge an old one, her brother's.  Travel from Eureka, where you interact with scientists and other interesting NPCs back home to Toon Town where you meet even more eccentric & lovable toons.

[h2]Second Major Quest (optional): The Radiance Prophecies.[/h2]
A second main quest line is the Radiance Prophecies. This quest line is a challenging extensive quest that rewards the player with a literal game changer. This quest line is for the hardcore RPG gamer who loves a challenge. It should be hard if the reward literally changes the game - right?

Of course there are lots of areas to explore along your way. Talk to all the NPCs and choose to help with their problems for numerous interesting side-quests.

[h2]Meet Xetior - the Uber-Boss of the Radiance Prophecies.[/h2]
This is the initial creation of Xetior of the Radiance Prophecies. Who will win the final show down? Wishlist Jaki's Wacky Adventure today & find out soon.

[previewyoutube=HISyOTovj1Y;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Jaki's Wacky Adventure to Launch Summer 2023 with Amazing New Features!
notes.content:
To you the loyal player, we want to apologize for the long period of silence. Rest assured we have been working round the clock to make Jaki's Wacky Adventure into an amazing experience for you to enjoy!

The much-anticipated launch date for Jaki's Wacky Adventure is now scheduled for January 2024. We have a ton to do before then. But hopefully by August you can travel to the exciting world of Harmony Haven. 

[h1]30 Unique Areas To Explore![/h1]
We have been busy designing over 30 unique areas for you to enjoy, explore and discover in this awesome open world. 

[h1]New! Three Difficulty Levels - Choose Your Own Game Play Experience![/h1]
One new feature is your choice of difficulty levels. Choose to experience Harmony Haven on a casual level. As a carefree fox, you have less enemies to worry about and can enjoy the story, quests, and scenery. As a crafty fox, you will find more enemies with nasty dispositions to challenge your skill. Finally, you can choose to throw caution to the wind and just go crazy. If you want to brag about your mastery skills, then try to achieve your black belt on crazy! Please share with us and the community when you do.

[h1]Meet the Newest Enemy to Defeat- Shadowspawn.[/h1]
We’d like to take time today to introduce you to Shadowspawn. Shadowspawn is one of the nastier enemies you will find as you travel through Harmony Haven, but he is no match for some of the clever bosses you will encounter.  Each boss has a trick up their sleeve. To beat the boss, you must first understand them. Good luck & have fun!

[previewyoutube=2Q8bbl8j72o;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]

Wishlist now so you don’t miss out on our launch day discount. Our scheduled release date is during the Wolf Moon - Jan 25th, 2024 (EST)!
